parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Source metabolism table. Join compound_records on substrate_record_id (mandatory). Join compound_structures on substrate molregno (mandatory). Join compound_records on metabolite_record_id (optional). Filter limit to first 200 rows. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key.
